## Ratings methodology

Who are they for? Business owners, sophisticated investors and anyone who wants to keep an eye on the economy. [...] What's included? Statistics include: the unemployment rate, the level of monthly retail sales, price changes for businesses and consumers as measured by the Producer Price Index and Consumer Price Index, monthly housing starts, and the quarterly Gross Domestic Product, which measures the value of all goods and services produced in the U.S. in a given calendar quarter.
